prompts.move: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PLAYER SPRITESHEET for Boom Buddies. Reference image1 is Pip identity (chestnut hair, youthful face, cream/teal colors); reference image2 is the new roster's polished pixel-art style and top-left lighting, NOT a character to copy. Redesign Pip into a distinctive charming young bomber adventurer: tousled chestnut hair, expressive amber-brown eyes, small orange neckerchief, short emerald open vest over cream shirt, teal shorts, compact leather belt with a navy bomb pouch, dark fingerless gloves, sturdy brown boots. No helmet or hat, no giant backpack, no weapon held. Cute squat RPG proportions but confident active stance. True crisp stepped navy outlines, disciplined rich 16-bit pixel-art texture; avoid smooth vector gradients. EXACT 4 columns ×4 rows =16 equal square cells, ONE same full-body character per cell, 18% transparent padding, equal scale and fixed foot baseline at 88% of cell height. Character head near 20% height. No text/labels/grid/background/shadows, genuine transparent alpha. Camera elevated top-down RPG. ROW1 all four faces DOWN/front. ROW2 all four faces UP/back, no front eyes visible. ROW3 all four faces LEFT/profile, noses point LEFT. ROW4 all four faces RIGHT/profile, noses point RIGHT. Every row columns: 1 idle alert; 2 walking left foot forward with opposite arm forward; 3 passing stride feet under body; 4 walking right foot forward with opposite arm forward. Preserve head location, hair, clothing, vest, scarf and bomb pouch across all frames. In LEFT row never include a right-facing frame. This is an engine-ready grid with consistent pivots, not a concept collage.
prompts.back: Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite expansion. Reference is Pip's new character identity. Create a SEPARATE transparent BACK-FACING walk sheet only. EXACT 2 columns ×2 rows =4 equal cells. ALL FOUR full-body sprites face AWAY from camera, looking UP, rear of hair, back of green vest, back of shorts and boots. Absolutely NO eyes, NO front face, NO front shirt buttons, NO belt buckle visible. Orange neckerchief knot and short tails visible from back; vest back has a simple seam, navy bomb pouch seen at hip only. Same chestnut tousled hair and outfit colors as reference. Elevated top-down 16-bit RPG pixel art, navy stepped outlines, top-left light, same scale and feet baseline at 88% height, 18% transparent margin. Cell1 back-facing idle; cell2 back walk left leg forward away from camera, right arm forward; cell3 back passing step; cell4 back walk right leg forward. Four genuine rear views. No text, no grid, no backdrop, no shadows.
prompts.actions: Use case: stylized-concept / game animation expansion. Reference is Pip's exact upgraded character identity: tousled chestnut hair, expressive brown eyes, orange neckerchief, emerald open vest over cream shirt, teal shorts, brown belt with navy bomb pouch, dark fingerless gloves and chunky brown boots. Preserve all identity, clothing, scale, palette and top-left lighting. ONE production transparent ACTION SPRITESHEET, EXACT 5 columns ×3 rows=15 equal cells. ONE full-body same character per cell, elevated top-down 16-bit RPG view, crisp stepped navy pixel outlines, no text/grid/background/shadow, 18% transparent margins and fixed feet baseline at 88% height. Row1 ALL face DOWN/front. Row2 ALL face UP/AWAY with back of head AND back of vest/shorts, no face or front buckle. Row3 ALL face RIGHT/profile, every nose points RIGHT. Across each row the five columns are: 1 preparing to place bomb, slight knee bend and gloved hand reaching toward waist pouch; 2 bomb placement release, crouching and one EMPTY gloved hand extended toward the ground (do NOT draw a bomb, engine draws bomb separately); 3 hurt recoil with expressive wince (rear direction reacts with body only), no gore; 4 victory, fist raised joyfully (rear still looking away); 5 defeat, seated tired/slumped at same foot baseline, nonviolent. Keep character, proportions and side-facing direction identical across each row, no extra objects. Runtime mirrors right-facing art for left-facing actions. Exact 5x3 grid matters.
prompts.rearActions: Use case: game sprite animation expansion. Use reference ONLY as identity and canonical rear-facing costume. Create six REAR VIEW action sprites of this same Pip, all facing AWAY/UP. Exact 3 columns by 2 rows. Every sprite shows back of chestnut hair, entirely emerald green BACK panel of vest with central seam, orange scarf knot, back of teal shorts, brown boots, gloves and navy pouch on side. ABSOLUTELY NO cream shirt chest, NO front shirt opening, NO belt buckle, NO face, NO eyes, NO front of torso. Back vest must be solid green panel in every pose. Top row left-to-right: preparing to place bomb with one hand at side pouch; crouched placing gesture with empty hand reaching ahead away from camera; hurt recoil while still facing away. Bottom row: victory rear view one fist raised away from camera; seated tired rear view; relaxed rear idle. SAME character scale and fixed foot baseline at 88% height. Polished 16-bit top-down RPG pixel art, crisp navy stepped outlines, top-left light. Real transparent background with 18% margins. No labels/grid/text/shadows or held bombs.
